title: Country file
source: BiceLib GameClasses/CCountry.hpp and CLASSES.md (`color`, `graphical_culture`, `major` among CCountry::LoadKey's keys, whose full list of 124 is not written out); project.json CMinister::LoadKey (0x12C630) and BiceLib GameClasses/CMinister.hpp for a minister; the rest from usage

file.desc: the country file's keys; CCountry::LoadKey reads it, and of its 124 keys only these are known to belong here

graphical_culture.desc: which set of models and pictures it uses; left out, `Generic`

last_election.desc: its last election before the start

default_templates.desc: division templates offered in the production screen

unit_names.desc: names for new units, by unit type

ministers.desc: the people who can hold its cabinet posts

patterns.desc: a template: its brigades, by unit type
names for new units of this type, in order

ministers.desc: each key is a minister's id

minister.desc: a minister: CMinister::LoadKey's six keys, then every other key a cabinet post he may hold = his minister type there

picture.desc: his portrait; without one he gets `empty_position`

patterns.desc: a post he may hold, and his type in it; a value that is no minister type loses the posting
